note: Lesotho: holders of the ordinary passports listed enter without a visa for 90 days, the EU's, Iceland's, New Zealand's, Norway's and Switzerland's for 14; everyone else needs a visa from a mission (the e-Visa portal is suspended; an emailed application may be possible, not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Read on 2026-11-03 against the Embassy of Lesotho in Washington's undated table of the countries whose citizens need a visa, and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' FAQ (a stay without a visa 'varies from 1 month to 3 months'): the table differs from Wikipedia's copy on some thirty passports but still names 'White Russia' and 'Former Zaire', so it is older than the rules Wikipedia's copy records, and is recorded here and not held.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Lesotho
sources.said: Visitors to Lesotho must obtain a visa from one of the Lesotho's diplomatic missions unless they are citizens of one of the visa-exempt countries. ... Holders of ordinary passports of the following countries and territories may enter Lesotho without a visa for the following period: 90 days Antigua and Barbuda Australia Bahamas Barbados Belize Brunei Botswana Canada Dominica Eswatini Gambia Grenada Guyana Hong Kong Israel Jamaica Japan Kenya Kiribati Malawi Malaysia Maldives Mauritius Namibia Nauru Papua New Guinea Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Samoa San Marino Sierra Leone Singapore Solomon Islands South Africa South Korea Sri Lanka Tanzania Tonga Trinidad and Tobago Tuvalu Uganda United Kingdom United States Vanuatu Zambia Zimbabwe 14 days All European Union member states Iceland New Zealand Norway Switzerland ... Electronic visa processing via the portal has been suspended.
